Urinary Bladder: -Underlying Incidence data are from SEER Incidence Data, November 2024 Submission (1975-2022), SEER 21 registries [https://seer.cancer.gov/registries/terms.html].

-Underlying Mortality data are from the NCHS public use data file. Mortality data used for Risk of Developing estimates are limited to mortality data from the SEER 21 registries [https://seer.cancer.gov/registries/terms.html].  Mortality data used for Risk of Dying estimates are for the total US.
-Risk estimates are calculated using the DevCan [https://surveillance.cancer.gov/devcan/] application.
-Incidence data for Hispanics and Non-Hispanics are based on the NAACCR Hispanic Latino Identification Algorithm (NHIA).
-Rates for American Indians/Alaska Natives only include cases that are in a Purchased/Referred Care Delivery Area (PRCDA).
-See SEER*Explorer Cancer Site Definitions [https://seer.cancer.gov/statistics-network/explorer/cancer-sites.html] for details about the cancer site coding used for SEER Incidence data.
-Cancer site cause of death is defined using the SEER Cause of Death Recode 1969+ (03/01/2018).
